Method of Attack: Automated attacks modifying JavaScript files in misconfigured Amazon S3 buckets by appending payment card skimming code
Discoverer: Willem de Groot from Sanguine Security
Impacted Systems: Websites using Amazon S3 buckets with misconfigured write permissions
More than 17,000 domains including popular ones in Alexa's top 2,000
962 online stores compromised in a related Magecart campaign
Attack Vector: Misconfigured Amazon S3 buckets with write permissions open to anyone
Indicators of Compromise: JavaScript files in S3 buckets appended with skimming code
